{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data structure
df.info()

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {patient_id_duplicates}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check assay_batch values
df['assay_batch'].value_counts()"}
